description: This file defines the ModifyCashierCommandHandler class, which handles commands to modify cashier information within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the modification logic to the CashierWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ModifyCashierCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles modification commands for cashiers by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and forwarding processing to the CashierWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to modify a cashier, delegating the operation to the writePlatformService's modifyCashier method.
